_comment: NeoForge dialect of the same recipe -- see the Fabric copy for why this is loader-specific.
The dispatch key is the literal `neoforge:ingredient_type`, NOT `type`: NeoForge's IngredientCodecs
dispatches on that string, and a `type` here is read as a HolderSet's type instead, which fails with
'Unknown registry key in ResourceKey[minecraft:root / neoforge:holder_set_type]'. The recipe is then
simply absent, with nothing but a line in the log to say so -- see BootLogCheck.
